whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Waffle Co.,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.5★ reviews in Danapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and dessert menu page for local customers.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, waffle varieties showcase, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://the-waffle-co-danapur-demo.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Waffle Co., Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (The Waffle Co. on Gola Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a showcase of your top-rated waffles in Danapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu prices aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein!"
